chunks: So, when the time of the first prediction came, We sent against you Our creatures full of martial might, who ransacked your cities; and the prediction was fulfilled.

key_terms.وَعْدُ أُولَاهُمَا: The first of the two predictions

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the first prediction (wa'd) in Surah Al-Isra?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the first major destruction of the Temple, historically linked to the Babylonian or Persian invasions, serving as a precursor to the second judgment. The phrase 'servants of ours with great might' underscores God's sovereign agency in using human agents to enact divine justice for the Children of Israel's covenantal breaches. This establishes a pattern of divine retribution that resonates with the broader Quranic theme of historical cycles of rise and fall based on moral conduct.
